segments.source: Milk residue, coffee residue, and mineral scale are separate jobs. Wipe and purge the wand after milk, rinse the basket after coffee, and follow the indicated group-cleaning and descaling routines. Breville says the group-cleaning reminder follows 200 extractions; that flushing cycle uses the supplied cleaning disc and a cleaning tablet. Descaling is a separate mineral-scale routine: the manual calls for descaling agent and removing the tank's water filter before adding it. Do not treat one alert or cycle as a substitute for the other. Breville also warns against distilled, demineralized, or highly filtered water.

segments.source: A modular station needs a maintenance plan for both machines. Brush and purge the grinder according to its manual, keep water away from burrs, and track the coffee used when changing settings. Clean the espresso group, baskets, steam wand and water system on the brewer’s schedule. Use appropriate water and record filter or treatment choices.
